title: Update GitHub prompts, copilot instructions, and AI agent configurations

subtasks.content: Read existing unit tests (`vscode-extension/src/test/unit/parser.test.ts`, `log-diagnostics.test.ts`, `style-checks.test.ts`) to extract Mocha/assert patterns for use as replacement examples

Delete `.github/skills/pytest-testing-patterns` and create `.github/skills/mocha-testing-patterns` with TypeScript/Mocha testing patterns (describe/it/assert, beforeEach, sinon, parametric, CLI commands) derived from existing unit tests

Rewrite `.github/prompts/Test Writing Best Practices.prompt.md` to replace all pytest examples with TypeScript/Mocha equivalents (assert.strictEqual, assert.deepStrictEqual, describe/it blocks, Mocha CLI commands, coverage goals)

Update `.github/prompts/Debugging LSP Server Issues.prompt.md` to remove pytest test examples, Python logging setup, pip install, and python -m references; replace with TypeScript/Mocha debugging workflows
Update `.github/prompts/LSP Feature Implementation.prompt.md` to replace @pytest.fixture and @pytest.mark.asyncio examples with Mocha beforeEach/describe/it patterns
Update `.github/prompts/Adding New CK3 Language Features.prompt.md` to replace Python code snippets and pytest.mark test examples with TypeScript equivalents
Update `.github/prompts/Branch Merge Assistant.prompt.md` to replace `pytest tests/ -v` and `flake8`/`mypy` commands with `npm run test:unit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format-check`
Update `.github/prompts/gh pr review.prompt.md` to replace `pytest tests/` with `npm run test:unit` in the code review workflow
Update `.github/prompts/Version Update Assistant.prompt.md` to remove pyproject.toml, python -m build, python -m twine, and pychivalry/__init__.py references

Update `.github/prompts/architecture_and_flow.md` to replace Python module names (server.py, parser.py, etc.) with TypeScript equivalents (server.ts, parser.ts, etc.) and update testing strategy section
Update `.github/prompts/documentation_standard.md` to replace Python docstring standards with TSDoc/TypeScript documentation conventions
Update `.github/skills/lsp-feature-debugging` Step 8 to replace pytest reproduction example with a Mocha describe/it test block
Update `.github/skills/lsp-performance-optimization` to replace @pytest.mark.performance, cProfile, memory_profiler, and benchmark fixture references with TypeScript profiling approaches
Update `.github/skills/ck3-validation-debugging` Step 9 to replace pytest-style test function and Python import examples with Mocha/TypeScript equivalents
Update `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to remove Python 3.9+, pytest, Black, flake8, mypy, pygls, hypothesis sections; remove Python folder structure; ensure TypeScript-only content throughout
Remove `Bash(pytest:*)`, `Bash(python:*)`, and the PowerShell `test_paradox_checks.py` entry from `.claude/settings.local.json`

Run `grep -ri` across `.github/`, `kanban-development-guideline.md`, and `.claude/settings.local.json` for pytest, pyproject, pygls, flake8, mypy, and 'python 3.9' to verify zero remaining Python references
